content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-31. - Protests; adjournment.
content.summary:

         …

faqs.a:
(a)
On the date and at the place fixed for a provisional order hearing, any and all property
               owners interested in such project may by specific and written complaints, protests
               or objections present their views in respect to the proposed projects to the council
               or may present them orally.
(b)
The council may adjourn the hearing from time-to-time.
(Code 1981, § 27-32; Ord. No. 551, § 14(A), 5-14-1964)
